title: Four-Digit Digital Clock
description: An interactive p5.js simulation displaying current time using four seven-segment digits with AM/PM indicator. Demonstrates seven-segment display logic and real-time clock functionality.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Digital Clock
Seven-Segment Display
Time Display
p5.js
learningObjectives: Identify which of the seven segments must light up to render each digit from 0 to 9
Explain how a binary segment map encodes the on/off state of every segment for a given digit
Describe how the simulation converts device time to a 12-hour display with an AM/PM indicator and leading-zero suppression
Trace how the blinking colon and once-per-minute updates are driven by the p5.js draw loop reading the system clock
